claim: Human activities are the main cause of the current global warming.
evidence_text: Human activities, primarily through greenhouse gas emissions, have unequivocally caused global warming. The evidence includes increasing atmospheric greenhouse gas concentrations and observed warming.
demo_notes: Strong, direct match to the claim; good first demo.

claim: The climate has not warmed since the late nineteenth century.
evidence_text: Earth's average surface temperature has risen by about 1 degree Celsius since the late nineteenth century, with most of the warming occurring in the past several decades.
demo_notes: Contradiction demo; model may need precise wording.

claim: Smoking increases the risk of lung cancer.
evidence_text: Cigarette smoking causes cancer and is a major cause of preventable disease. Smoking can cause cancer in many parts of the body, including the lungs.

claim: Antibiotics cure viral infections such as the common cold.
evidence_text: Antibiotics do not work on viruses. They will not help you feel better if you have a virus, such as those that cause colds, flu, or COVID-19.
demo_notes: Contradiction example; do not use for personal medical decisions.

evidence_text: Earth is the third planet from the Sun and travels around the Sun in an orbit.

claim: The ozone layer and climate change are exactly the same environmental problem.
evidence_text: Ozone depletion and climate change are distinct environmental issues with different primary mechanisms, although some chemicals and policies can affect both.
demo_notes: Tests a conflated claim; interpretation may be mixed depending on wording.

claim: Vaccines train the immune system to recognize and fight specific pathogens.
evidence_text: Vaccines train the immune system to create antibodies, just as it does when exposed to a disease. After vaccination, the immune system is better able to recognize and fight the pathogen.
demo_notes: General educational example; avoid individual medical conclusions.

claim: A strong password is the only security measure ever needed to protect an online account.
evidence_text: Using strong passwords is important, and multi-factor authentication adds another layer of protection by requiring an additional form of verification.
demo_notes: The word 'only' makes this claim overly absolute.

claim: Earthquakes can occur when stress causes rocks to slip along faults.
evidence_text: Earthquakes occur when rocks suddenly slip along a fault. Stress builds up and is released when the rocks move, generating seismic waves.
demo_notes: Clear science claim suitable for a live demonstration.

claim: Water is made of hydrogen and oxygen.
evidence_text: A water molecule contains two hydrogen atoms bonded to one oxygen atom, giving water the chemical formula H2O.

claim: A single cold day proves that global warming is not happening.
evidence_text: Weather describes short-term atmospheric conditions, while climate describes patterns over longer periods. A cold day or local cold spell does not by itself disprove a long-term global warming trend.
demo_notes: Good opportunity to explain weather versus climate.

claim: A secret underwater city was discovered yesterday and all governments confirmed it.
demo_notes: Use to demonstrate uncertainty. The local evidence store may not contain relevant material.
